name: Dialog
description: A modal surface that owns focus management, naming, dismissal, and scroll locking.

anatomy.description: The control that opens the dialog, usually a Button; callers own it.
The dimmed backdrop that blocks the page and dismisses on click.
The modal surface that traps focus and carries the title, description, and children.
Header text wired to aria-labelledby and aria-describedby automatically.

dos: Use a verb-led title that states the outcome, like "Archive project?".
Keep the content short; move long forms into a dedicated page or a Drawer.
Restore focus to the trigger when the dialog closes (built in).
donts: Don't stack a second dialog on top of an open one.
Don't use a dialog for destructive confirmations; use AlertDialog.
Don't hide required information behind the scrim dismissal.

examples.title: Confirmation
examples.description: Dialog traps focus, restores it on close, and dismisses with Escape or the scrim.

examples.title: Form dialog
examples.description: size="lg" gives a short form room; Field wraps each Input with a label and description.

examples.title: Destructive confirmation
examples.description: Use a danger action only when the consequence is clear and reversible where possible.

examples.title: Long-form task
examples.description: For focused tasks, keep the title visible and let the dialog body own its scroll.

guidance.useWhen: A decision or focused task must temporarily block the page.
guidance.avoidWhen: The content can be inline or handled by a popover.
guidance.behavior: Focus is trapped, Escape dismisses, and focus returns to the trigger.
guidance.responsive: Use the built-in size and allow the body to scroll inside the panel.

keyboard.action: Closes the dialog and returns focus to the trigger.
Cycles focus through the focusable elements inside the dialog.

notes: Renders role="dialog" with aria-modal, labelled by the title and described by the description.
Focus moves into the dialog on open and is restored to the trigger on close.
Background content is scroll-locked while the dialog is open.
